name: The Fifth Horseman
source:
The Fifth Horseman is a choose-your-own-adventure game with RPG elements that is set in a fantasy-medieval world.

You wake up in an apocalyptic world with no memories of your past. You feel an energy drawing you to the city of Eden, the last city of Earth. Throughout your journey you must discover who you are and also unravel the mysteries of the city.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《第五骑士》是一款带有RPG元素的自选冒险游戏，背景设定在奇幻中世纪世界。

你在一个世界末日中醒来，对过去没有任何记忆。你感觉到一股能量将你吸引到伊甸城，地球上最后的城市。在整个旅程中，你必须发现自己是谁，并揭开这座城市的神秘面纱。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048090/]Steam[/url]]
